artifacts.result.json: every number of the ladder, cross-checks and sensitivity studies

limitations: K_t = 3 is the infinite-plate limit; the finite-width plate is pushed to d/W = 0.02 and Richardson-extrapolated in h, and the d/W trend is graded against the Howland/Heywood fit rather than claimed to be 3.
The Q8 annulus check prescribes the exact Kirsch displacement on r = 2a, so it certifies the discretisation only and cannot see the far-field/finite-width model error.
Plane stress, linear elasticity, isotropic homogeneous material, single hole, no plasticity and no contact: this anchor says nothing about those regimes.

The plate-length study must be resolution-matched (n ~ L): with the ray count held fixed the starburst mesh coarsens near the apex and K_t drifts by percent-level in a way that mimics a load-introduction effect. Both tables are in result.json.

The hole edge is a stress-raiser: the Q4 recovered nodal stress converges at an observed order near 2 on this mesh family, which is a property of the starburst mesh plus apex node, not a general O(h^2) claim.
